entries.title: What the science says
entries.content: In Christopher French's studies, people holding real quartz or fake glass reported the same tingles and calm. That points to suggestion and belief, not the stone itself.
entries.source: Crystal Therapy - Asian Journal of Nursing Education and Research; French (Goldsmiths) studies
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Why rituals still help
entries.content: Simple rituals, like holding an object while setting an intention, can lower anxiety and help people feel in control. A crystal can be that kind of reminder.
entries.source: Psychology of rituals research; Crystal Healing: What the Science Actually Shows
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Jade (Wood)
entries.content: Jade has been a protective, long-life stone in Chinese and Korean tradition for thousands of years. Giun pairs it with Wood and anger: hold it during your cool-down break.
entries.source: Crystal Healing: What the Science Actually Shows; Korean jade tradition
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Amethyst (Fire)
entries.content: Its Greek name means 'not intoxicated'; it was believed to keep the mind clear. Giun pairs it with Fire and over-excitement: a wind-down ritual before sleep.
entries.source: Crystal Therapy - Asian Journal of Nursing Education and Research
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Citrine (Earth)
entries.content: Citrine is traditionally used for brightness and positivity. Giun pairs it with Earth and worry: hold it while you write the evidence for and against a worry.
entries.source: Crystal Therapy - Asian Journal of Nursing Education and Research
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Rose quartz (Metal)
entries.content: Rose quartz is the traditional stone for heartache. Giun pairs it with Metal and grief: hold it while you write kindly to yourself.
entries.source: Crystal Therapy - Asian Journal of Nursing Education and Research
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Black tourmaline (Water)
entries.content: Black tourmaline is traditionally a grounding, protective stone. Giun pairs it with Water and fear: hold it during slow breathing before one brave step.
entries.source: Crystal Healing: What the Science Actually Shows
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Buy wisely
entries.content: Crystals are for ritual and beauty, not treatment. Don't pay extra for healing claims, and never use them in place of medical care.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
